Court Acquits 13 in 2020 Delhi Riots Case

A Delhi court acquitted 13 individuals accused in the 2020 Delhi riots case. The court stated it was unsafe to rely on tainted witness testimony and cited doubts over key witnesses. CCTV footage was also noted as unclear. The acquittals provide significant relief to the accused.
